{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS068 |prevtitle=Jigglypuff Jive |nextcode=PS070 |nexttitle=Allied by Alazakam! |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Playing Horsea |title_ja=VSタッツー |title_ro=VS Tattu |image=PS069.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 69 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 29 in [[Agatha's Arbok]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 69 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Playing Horsea''' (Japanese: '''VSタッツー''' ''VS {{tt|Tattu|Horsea}}'') is the 69th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 29th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Adv|Green}} and {{Adv|Bill}} jump down from [[Jiggly]] right in front of {{Adv|Yellow}}. Green says that "it feels like jacket weather" and puts a jacket on. Yellow and Green start to talk, while Bill guesses that Green sent Yellow on his quest and helped them when Lorelei attacked them, both being correct. He also thinks that something unknown that Green told him is true. Green gets Bill and Yellow to ride on Jiggly and tells her {{p|Horsea}} to put a {{m|Smokescreen}} around them. In the air, they see some {{p|Slowbro}} looking for trespassers, and these Slowbro make [[Cerise Island]] so cold. Yellow looks at his map of Cerise Island, but he can't read it. Bill asks for the map, and an unfortunate movement causes the map to fall to the ground, where a {{p|Slowbro}} finds the map. Green, Yellow, and Bill mentally plead for the Slowbro to throw the map away. The Slowbro eats the map. Then it moves away to report the event to its Trainer. Green's Horsea latches itself onto a spike on the Slowbro's tail and leaves a trail of ink. Meanwhile, [[Erika]] is fighting off {{type|Ice}} Pokémon from Lorelei's army in [[Celadon City]]. In {{ci|Cerulean}} and {{ci|Pewter}} Cities [[Misty]] and [[Brock]] are fighting against the {{type|Ghost}} and {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon from Agatha's and Bruno's armies, as yet another, larger, army flies to [[Kanto]]. Back on Cerise Island, the Slowbro and Horsea go inside the island. Green then notices {{p|Clefable|Clefy}} rattling inside its {{i|Poké Ball}}. Yellow senses that {{p|Clefable}} is saying that it hears voices from someone they know, and it is surprised but not scared. They then see the people, [[Lt. Surge]], [[Koga]], and [[Sabrina]] from [[Team Rocket]]. ==Major events== * {{adv|Bill}} and {{Adv|Green}} reach [[Cerise Island]] * Bill, Green, and {{Adv|Yellow}} meet up with the others. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Slowbro}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Bill}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Brock]] * [[Lt.
